g.text: Ionisation energy rises across a period

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0e1f40

g.text: Across a period the nuclear charge grows while the shell stays the same: the atoms shrink and hold their electrons more tightly.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #64748b

g.text: The two dips (circled) are at Al, where a lone 3p electron enters a new subshell, and at S, where a paired 3p electron repels its partner.
